name: sovereign-browser
description: A standalone Electron browser prototype named Sovereign.

scripts.build:ai: mkdir -p src/generated && esbuild src/ai/ai-engine-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=src/generated/ai-engine.bundle.js && esbuild src/pdf-extract-worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=src/generated/pdf-extract-worker.js && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs src/generated/pdf.worker.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build:ai && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.check: npm run build:ai && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/sidebar.js && node --check src/search.js && node --check src/ask.js && node --check src/model-setup.js && node --check src/search-backend.js && node --check src/search-utils.js && node --check src/source-reader.js && node --check src/summary-utils.js && node --check src/privacy-receipt.js && node --check src/newtab.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check src/downloads.js && node --check src/bookmarks.js && node --check src/theme.js && node --check src/ai/ai-engine-entry.js && node --check src/pdf-extract-worker.js && node tests/privacy-receipt.test.js && node tests/audit-compare.test.js && npm run check:tests
scripts.check:tests: node --check tests/electron/model-chat.test.js && node --check tests/electron/auto-setup-shutdown.test.js && node --check tests/electron/generation-shutdown.test.js && node --check tests/electron/downloads.test.js && node --check tests/electron/browser-features.test.js && node --check tests/electron/ui-smoke.test.js && node --check tests/electron/stage1-usability.test.js && node --check tests/electron/attachments.test.js && node --check tests/electron/home-attachments.test.js && node --check tests/electron/pdf-attachments.test.js && node --check tests/electron/media-chat.test.js
scripts.test:electron:model-chat: npm run build:ai && node --check tests/electron/model-chat.test.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron tests/electron/model-chat.test.js
scripts.test:electron:auto-setup-shutdown: npm run build:ai && node --check tests/electron/auto-setup-shutdown.test.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron tests/electron/auto-setup-shutdown.test.js
